# `glyph`

Glyph written on a wall: pentagram, grid of runes, alchemical circle or tally. This template is an **overlay**: transparent by design, meant to be laid over another patch.

![glyph](../images/glyph.png)

Category: [dungeon](../catalog.md#dungeon).

Own size: 32 × 32 pixels. Parameters marked **layout** are expressed at this size and scale with the patch; **detail** parameters are real pixels and never scale. See [Layout and detail](../concepts.md#layout-and-detail).

## Parameters

### General

| Parameter | Type                            | Default       | Scale | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| --------- | ------------------------------- | ------------- | ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `size`    | [width, height] of integers > 0 | `[32, 32]`    | —     | own size of the patch in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `type`    | string                          | `"pentagram"` | —     | pentagram: an inverted five-pointed star, one point down, inside concentric circles; grid: a 3 × 3 grid, unreadable characters in some squares; alchemy: an alchemical or astrological circle, its figure picked by the seed; tally: strokes counting days, the fifth across the four others |
| `chaos`   | number in [0, 1]                | `0.15`        | —     | jitter of the scribing, in [0, 1]: 0 is a steady hand, 1 a shaking one; tally strokes also lean and vary in length                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `age`     | number in [0, 1]                | `0.3`         | —     | overall aging, from 0 (fresh) to 1 (nearly erased): sets every wear parameter left unset                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `fading`  | number in [0, 1]                | from `age`    | —     | cloudy variation of the alpha of the writing, in [0, 1]: blotches worn away, the rest faint                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

### `grid`

The grid type.

| Parameter     | Type              | Default | Scale | Description                                         |
| ------------- | ----------------- | ------- | ----- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `grid.filled` | integer in [0, 9] | `5`     | —     | grid only: squares holding a character, from 0 to 9 |

### `tally`

The tally type.

| Parameter     | Type              | Default | Scale | Description                                 |
| ------------- | ----------------- | ------- | ----- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `tally.count` | integer in [1, 5] | `5`     | —     | tally only: the number counted, from 1 to 5 |

### `stroke`

The strokes of the writing.

| Parameter          | Type             | Default     | Scale  | Description                                           |
| ------------------ | ---------------- | ----------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `stroke.color`     | CSS color        | `"#d8d0bc"` | —      | color of the writing: chalk by default                |
| `stroke.alpha`     | number in [0, 1] | `0.9`       | —      | alpha of the writing, in [0, 1]                       |
| `stroke.thickness` | number ≥ 1       | `1`         | detail | thickness of the strokes, in pixels                   |
| `stroke.grain`     | number in [0, 1] | `0.08`      | —      | random brightness variation between pixels, in [0, 1] |

## Usage

`glyph` is an overlay: a sign written on the wall, transparent elsewhere. `type` picks
the sign:

- `pentagram`: an inverted five-pointed star, one point down, inside two concentric
  circles;
- `grid`: a 3 × 3 grid, an unreadable character of a few strokes in `grid.filled` of its
  squares, picked by the seed;
- `alchemy`: an alchemical circle: a double ring divided by ticks, a triangle, a square
  or a hexagram inscribed in it, small circles on its vertices and a circle in its heart;
  the seed picks the figure and the divisions;
- `tally`: days counted by a prisoner, `tally.count` from 1 to 5, the fifth stroke
  across the four others.

```json
{
  "size": [64, 64],
  "patches": [
    { "patch": { "template": "ashlar" }, "width": 100, "height": 100 },
    {
      "patch": { "template": "glyph", "type": "alchemy", "age": 0.6 },
      "x": 12.5,
      "y": 12.5,
      "width": 75,
      "height": 75
    }
  ]
}
```

- The sign is drawn in the largest square centered in the patch, and scales with it; the
  strokes keep their `stroke.thickness`, in pixels.
- `chaos` shakes the hand: each stroke wanders off its path, and tally strokes lean and
  vary in length.
- Chalk by default: a `stroke.color` such as `#8e1b14` paints it in red.
- As it ages, the writing fades in cloudy blotches (`fading`): some parts worn away, the
  others faint.

## Aging

`age`, from 0 (new) to 1 (ruined), sets every wear parameter left unset. Values in
between are interpolated linearly between age 0, 0.3 (the default) and 1. Parameters set
explicitly always win: `{ "age": 0.8, "stains": { "ratio": 0 } }` is a ruined wall
without streaks. See [Aging](../concepts.md#aging).

![glyph at age 0, 0.3, 0.6 and 1](../images/glyph-ages.png)

With its default parameters, `glyph` derives:

| Parameter | age 0 | age 0.3 | age 0.6 | age 1 |
| --------- | ----- | ------- | ------- | ----- |
| `fading`  | 0     | 0.35    | 0.63    | 1     |

## Example

```json
{
  "$schema": "../../schemas/patch.schema.json",
  "template": "glyph",
  "size": [32, 32]
}
```
